title: Diagonal-free second trace rearrangement
statement:
Fix a prime ell, a finite extension E of Q_ell and a scheme S where ell is invertible. Let p be a normalized projective-line tower Presentation, d its Maps and h its EtaleOriginComparisonsWithLine, as in [lem-sp-tower-p1-etale-origin-comparisons]. All words below are the actual derived tensor, projection and mate words of [def-sp-tower-p1-triangle-words]. The precise assertion is:
theorem towerP1SecondTraceReordering (p : Presentation l E S hS) (d : Maps l E p)
    (h : EtaleOriginComparisonsWithLine l E p d)
    (K : C l E p.classes.base S) :
    unitTail l E d ((rightRestricted l E d).obj K) ≫
        (p.G l E).map (epsilon l E d K) =
      (SpTowerShriek.push l E p.classes.base
        (p.operations.geometry (pullback.snd _ _))).map
          ((SpTowerShriek.tensor l E p.classes.base (diagonalSurface S)).map
            (Prod.mkHom (rightPullComparison l E p K.obj).hom (𝟙 _))) ≫
      contractionTail l E h true ((rightRestricted l E d).obj K)

proof.text: put N=q*K tensor T. Apply exchange/tensor coherence to the q square at inside T and outside K. It equates exchange_N after pullback of projection_q(K,T) with projection_p2(q*K,p1*T) after identity tensor exchange_T. All these comparisons are invertible on the domains supplied by Maps and EtaleOriginComparisonsWithLine; invert the equation. Tensor associativity for projection extracts the last T in unitTail_N. The comparison rightPullComparison is exactly the square on q*K and line1Iso followed by inverse line2Iso on its T factor. The two copies of the unshifted Tate line have identity self-symmetry: on a common root frame multiplication rs equals sr, and the equation is invariant under change of frame. Moving [2] past degree j contributes (-1)^(2j)=1, and swapping its two copies contributes (-1)^4=1, also when ell=2. Thus the extracted word is pullback(projection_q) tensor identity, followed by inverse exchange_T and the swap of the two line factors. On composing with G(epsilon_K), the adjacent projection and its inverse cancel. By the definition of projectionTrace true the remaining inverse exchange followed by pulled trace is the projection trace; symmetry naturality for this trace and the unitors moves it to the last factor. The resulting word is precisely contractionTail true after the pushed tensor of rightPullComparison. No equality of general derived maps is inferred from their level evaluations.
